metadata.description: Annotatable UI preview for DeepSeek Harness: four responsive frames, element-level Edit UI, and exact surgical targets sent to the agent.
metadata.name: dsh-visual-sandbox

paragraphs.text: Annotatable UI preview for DeepSeek Harness: four responsive frames, element-level Edit UI, and exac
t surgical targets sent to the agent.

**Visual Sandbox** puts your UI in the right half of DeepSeek Harness and turns review into
pointing

. Hover a block, see its selector, click to pin it, type one line — the agent gets an
exact target i
nstead of a paragraph of description.

It renders workspace HTML in four honest frames, lets you inspect real DOM elements, and
queues ever

y annotation until you send it. The agent then edits **only** the blocks you
touched.
## Highlights
| **Studio header** | The right panel opens on a three-field studio header: **Device & Type**, **Ver
sion**, and **Source (Workspace or URL)**. A second row holds **Inspect**, **Edit UI**, **Select** (

Element or Region), **Preview scale**, and **Send All**. |
| **Four frames** | Responsive (fluid), M
obile `390×844`, Tablet `768×1024`, Desktop `1024×720`. Fixed frames fit to the available **width**
and scroll vertically when needed, so Mobile is shown near actual size instead of shrinking to fit t

he height. Frames stay centered until they genuinely overflow the canvas. |
| **Preview scale** | Ch
oose Fit, 50%, 75%, 100%, **110%**, **120%**, 125%, 150%, or 200%. Fixed frames pan and scroll when
they exceed the canvas, so a mobile prototype can be reviewed at actual size or larger. Responsive s

tays full-bleed. |
| **Edit UI** | Hover outlines with live selector tags, click to pin, popover for

the note. `Enter` sends, `Shift+Enter` breaks the line. |
| **Surgical by design** | `[#1 mobile: b
utton.seg]` plus box, computed styles, HTML and text reach the agent with a standing rule: change on

ly these targets. |
| **Auto-detected sources** | The newest workspace `.html`/`.htm` file loads its
elf; a restored source that no longer exists falls back to the newest discovered file instead of sho
wing a 404. Localhost URLs work for dev servers, Expo web, Flutter web, Tauri or Electron renderers.

|
| **Open by default** | The panel reveals itself when a Session opens; the sparkle mark toggles i

t shut and open again, always landing on the newest preview. |
| **Version field** | A real **Versio
n** dropdown in the header; workspace files default to the latest render and can flip to an older on

e. With no history, the field is disabled and shows **Latest**. |
| **DeepSeek blue** | The studio a
ccent, active controls, Send All gradient, empty-state art, hover highlight and focus rings use Deep
Seek blue instead of purple. |
## Install

**Requires** DeepSeek Harness (desktop app or `dsh web`) with a working profile.
The plugin ships as
a bundle package — install it from your clone, not from npm.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then register it in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A git dependency works too, if you would rather not keep a local clone:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart Harness and **refresh the app page once** so the client half loads. The plugin then
appears
as *Visual Sandbox* in the right sidebar's guide.
> **Upgrading:** `git pull`, `pnpm install`, restart, refresh.
## Use it

1. **Load a source.** Type a workspace path such as `index.html`, pick one from the chevron
list, or

paste `http://localhost:3000`. Press Enter.
2. **Pick a frame.** Use **Device & Type** for Responsi

ve, Mobile, Tablet or Desktop. Use
**Preview scale** to enlarge a fixed frame (100%, 110%, 120% and

above); the canvas scrolls
when the prototype is larger than the panel.
3. **Switch to Edit UI.** Ch

oose **Element** or **Region** in **Select**. Hover a block — it
outlines and names its selector. Cl

ick it.
4. **Write the note** and press Enter. Repeat for each block that is wrong.
5. **Send All**,
add context in the chat, and let the agent make the surgical edit.

The panel can also be opened from the sparkle mark — the same button closes it again — or by
the age

nt through `open_visual_sandbox`. Opening always restores the newest preview for the
Session, so the
workbench never lands empty.
### Versions

The **Version** field is always part of the studio header. For a workspace file it lists that
file's

real render history — the first load, each agent refresh, each re-read from disk —
newest first, wi

th **latest** selected by default. Identical documents fold into the previous
entry instead of pilin

g up. Picking an older entry swaps the preview immediately, without
touching the file on disk.

A URL preview, or a file that has no history yet, leaves the field inactive and disabled with
the te

xt **Latest**. Snapshots live in Host memory for the process lifetime, capped at 8
versions / 8 MB p
er Session; documents larger than 2 MB stay previewable but are not recorded.
### What an annotation records
| Field | Content |

| `id` + note | Stable number and the text you typed |
| `platformMode` + viewport | Which frame it

was measured in, e.g. `mobile 390x844` |
| `selector` | Unique CSS path (`#id` when unique, otherwis

e `tag:nth-of-type` chains) |
| `html` / `text` | Cleanly truncated `outerHTML` and visible text |
|

`box` + normalized % | Pixel rectangle plus x/y/width/height inside the app window |
| `styles` | L
ayout, color, typography, border, flex/grid and shadow values |

Cross-origin URL frames cannot be inspected, so there you drag a rectangle instead — the
same number
ed pin and note flow applies.
## Sources

1. **Auto-detected workspace HTML** — scans the workspace (skipping `node_modules`, `.git`,
`.next`,

`.nuxt`, caches), lists newest first, loads the newest when nothing is active.
2. **Local URL** — a

ny `http://`/`https://` preview, including dev servers and native-webview
targets.

Workspace previews inline local stylesheets, scripts, images, media, fonts and CSS
`url(...)` assets

into one self-contained document; CSP and `<base>` tags are stripped.
[该节后续省略]
## Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| File | Role |
| `index.js` | Host half: Session state, the three routes, the five tools, prompt section, HTML inli

ner, file discovery, version snapshots. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: frames, studio header, versi

on field, dotted canvas, inspector bridge, annotation tray, header toggle, host sync. |
| `cordis.pa

tch.yml` | Registers the plugin under the `dsh-visual-sandbox` bundle id. |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json`

| Plugin inventory title and description. |
| `icon.svg` | The mark used by the sidebar guide. |
